Vzhledem k povaze zakázky, tedy terénní náročnosti a vzhledem ke klimatickým a časovým podmínkám, se Zadavatel rozhodl dělit zakázku na části. normalized.description: VITO is searching for candidates for the design, engineering (concept, basic and detail), construction, delivery, installation and commissioning (with CE-label) of a Multi purpose reactor. To validate and demonstrate the different synthesis routes towards plant-based applications, VITO aims for an extension of the current pilot infrastructure platform with a multi-purpose reactor. This set-up will consist of three mixed batch reactors in the range of 50 L, with requirements for elevated and chilled temperature, pressure and chemicals. Next to the reactors, the set-up will also include the required downstream processing steps to be applied after the reaction.
